# Revly

> Review management software for software companies. Revly collects reviews with one
> smart link, monitors every review platform in a single dashboard, drafts on-brand
> responses, embeds review widgets on your own site, and connects your review data to
> Claude and ChatGPT over MCP.

Revly is built for SaaS and software companies whose products get reviewed on G2,
Capterra, the app stores and marketplace listings. It is used by marketing teams
running review programs, and by agencies managing reviews for multiple clients.

What makes it different from sending review request emails by hand: Revly screens for
sentiment before asking, so unhappy customers reach support instead of a public review
form; it routes each happy customer to the platform you need reviews on; and its AI
helps the customer expand a short comment into a detailed review in their own words,
which they read, edit and post themselves. Revly never writes reviews on a customer's
behalf or posts without their approval.

## Product

- [Collect quality reviews](https://revly.io/collect-quality-reviews/): one smart link plus AI writing assistance
- [Monitor review platforms](https://revly.io/monitor-platforms/): every platform in one dashboard
- [Send smart review requests](https://revly.io/smart-review-requests/): sentiment screening and routing
- [Manage review responses](https://revly.io/manage-review-responses/): AI-drafted replies in your voice
- [Display reviews on your site](https://revly.io/review-widgets/): embeddable, self-updating review widgets
- [Query your review data with AI](https://revly.io/claude-mcp/): Revly MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT

## Blog

Research on how the review platforms actually work, checked against their own
documentation and primary sources.

- [Blog index](https://revly.io/blog/)
- [G2 acquired Capterra. What it changes for your review programme.](https://revly.io/blog/g2-capterra-acquisition-review-management/): G2 now owns Capterra, Software Advice and GetApp. Capterra reviews still do not syndicate to G2, incentive rules still differ, and collection is still two separate campaigns.
- [How many G2 reviews do you actually need?](https://revly.io/blog/how-many-g2-reviews-do-you-need/): 10 reviews in a category for a Grid Report, 20 at a 4.0 average for Users Love Us, plus how G2's review decay curve works.

## Monitored platforms

G2, Capterra, GetApp, Software Advice, Trustpilot, Apple App Store, Google Play Store,
Shopify App Store, WooCommerce Marketplace, QuickBooks Marketplace, WordPress Plugin
Marketplace, Xero Marketplace.
